The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of ANITHA.V..

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 10-03-2008 and after the marriage accused subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by Suspecting her character, abusing her in filthy words, assaulting her, harassing her to get money from her maternal house, coming to the house under the influence of alcohol, demanding CW-1 give him money.
On 06-11-2018 the accused came to the house under the influence of alcohol and snatched mangalasutra from the neck of CW-1 forcibly.

On 20-11- 2018 the accused abused her in filthy language and on 07-12-2018 the accused harassed CW-1 to hand over her jewelry to him,
assaulted on her face, back and on stomach with his hands,
abused her in filthy language and also criminally intimidated to do away with her life and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.119/2018  3  C.C.No.9789/2019 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I.
Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: 9 . POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused

,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
5  C.C.No.9789/2019  10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Anitha.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 10-03-2008 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court Anitha V vs Krishanamurthy S on 3 December, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30443423/
4 was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon  6  C.C.No.9789/2019 other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 506 of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 03-12 -2025).
